# package master

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-canopen/master"
```

Package master is a CANopen network manager (an NMT master with the services a CiA 302 manager uses): NMT commands, heartbeat supervision, emergency reception, SDO clients for every node, network scan, node configuration (from entries or a DCF), a boot procedure, remote PDOs, SYNC and TIME production, CiA 402 drive control, an LSS master, MPDO configuration, CANopen FD (USDO) and the CiA 302 manager.

	m, _ := master.New(bus, master.WithEventHandler(func(e master.Event) { log.Print(e) }))
	_ = m.Start()
	defer m.Close()
	nodes, _ := m.Scan(ctx, nil)
	_ = m.Configure(ctx, 5, []master.Entry{{Index: 0x1017, Data: []byte{0xE8, 0x03}}})
	_ = m.Monitor(5, 1500*time.Millisecond)
	_ = m.StartNode(ctx, 5)

#### Events {#hdr-Events}

Everything the master observes is delivered as an [Event](#type-event) to the single handler of [WithEventHandler](#func-witheventhandler): boot-ups, state changes, heartbeat losses and resumptions (of nodes supervised with [Master.Monitor](#func-master-monitor) or a boot configuration), emergency messages and the end of boot procedures. Events are delivered in order, one at a time, on a goroutine of the master's own through an unbounded queue, so the handler may use the master (SDO, NMT) without stalling the network services; it must not call [Master.Close](#func-master-close).

#### SDO {#hdr-SDO}

[Master.SDO](#func-master-sdo) returns the cached client of a node (default COB-IDs). Transfers to one node are serialised by its client; different nodes are served in parallel. [Master.Scan](#func-master-scan) uses short-lived clients with a short timeout instead, so that absent nodes do not delay it.

#### Configuration {#hdr-Configuration}

A configuration is a list of [Entry](#type-entry) values (index, sub-index, encoded value): the neutral form a DCF ([DCFEntries](#func-dcfentries)), a tool or code produces. [Master.Configure](#func-master-configure) writes it; the entries of PDO parameters are applied per PDO with pdo.Configure, so the sequence of CiA 301 (invalidate, clear the mapping, map, enable, make valid) holds however the entries are ordered. [Master.ConfigureFromDCF](#func-master-configurefromdcf) does both steps for a DCF.

#### Boot procedure {#hdr-Boot_procedure}

[Master.SetBoot](#func-master-setboot) registers a [BootConfig](#type-bootconfig) for a node: each boot-up of the node then checks its device type and identity, configures it, supervises its heartbeat and starts it, in the background, reporting EventBootDone or EventBootFailed. [Master.Boot](#func-master-boot) runs the same procedure on demand.

#### PDOs {#hdr-PDOs}

[Master.ListenTPDO](#func-master-listentpdo) reads a node's TPDO configuration over SDO and decodes the PDOs it sends; [Master.RPDOSender](#func-master-rpdosender) produces a node's RPDO. [Master.Listen](#func-master-listen) and [Master.Sender](#func-master-sender) take the COB-ID and mapping directly. Decoding and encoding need a dictionary describing the node's objects (its EDS, or the dictionary it was built from).

#### SYNC, TIME, heartbeat {#hdr-SYNC__TIME__heartbeat}

[Master.SYNC](#func-master-sync) and [Master.TIME](#func-master-time) are the master's producers on the default COB-IDs; set a SYNC period to drive synchronous PDOs. With [WithHeartbeat](#func-withheartbeat) the master sends its own heartbeat, for nodes that supervise it.

#### CiA 402 {#hdr-CiA_402}

[Master.Drive](#func-master-drive) returns a cia402.Controller operating a node's drive over the node's SDO client.

#### CiA 302 manager {#hdr-CiA_302_manager}

With [WithDictionary](#func-withdictionary) the master is a CANopen device of its own (a node.Node on the given dictionary) and a CiA 302 manager driven by the objects of that dictionary ([AddManagerObjects](#func-addmanagerobjects) adds them):

  - 0x1F80 NMT start-up (Startup\* bits): bit 0 makes the device the NMT master; the others select whether the slaves are started all at once, whether the master and the slaves are started by the application, and the reaction to an error control event of a mandatory slave (reset or stop all nodes).
  - 0x1F81 NMT slave assignment per node ([Assignment](#type-assignment)): network list, boot, mandatory, keep-alive, software version check and update, restore, and the node guarding parameters.
  - 0x1F82 request NMT and 0x1F83 request node guarding: writes send NMT commands and start or stop guarding; reads return the node's state and guarding.
  - 0x1F84..0x1F88 expected identification, 0x1F89 boot time.
  - 0x1F22 concise DCF, 0x1F26/0x1F27 expected configuration date and time, 0x1F8A restore configuration (CiA 302-3 configuration).
  - 0x1F55 expected application software identification, 0x1F58 program data (CiA 302-3 program download).

At every boot-up of the master's node (Start, and its resets) with bit 0 of 0x1F80 set, the network boot-up of CiA 302-2 runs ([Master.BootNetwork](#func-master-bootnetwork)): the slaves are reset (communication), and each slave of the network list goes through the boot slave process ([Master.BootSlave](#func-master-bootslave)) when its boot-up arrives (a mandatory slave without one is booted after BootTiming.ResetTimeout, a keep-alive slave at once): identity check, software check and update ([Master.DownloadProgram](#func-master-downloadprogram)), configuration (skipped when the slave's 0x1020 matches 0x1F26/0x1F27; else restore and the concise DCF, written in order with [Master.ConfigureConcise](#func-master-configureconcise), optionally followed by a store request, [WithStoreAfterConfigure](#func-withstoreafterconfigure)), start of the error control (heartbeat from 0x1016, else node guarding from 0x1F81), then NMT start as 0x1F80 allows. A slave that does not answer is retried (a mandatory one within the boot time 0x1F89). Once every mandatory slave booted the master enters Operational (unless 0x1F80 bit 2) and starts the slaves; a failing mandatory slave halts the boot-up. Results are events (EventBootDone, EventBootFailed with a \*BootError holding the CiA 302 error status letter, EventNetworkBootDone, EventNetworkBootFailed); a lost slave (heartbeat or node guarding) is reset, or all nodes are reset or stopped, as 0x1F80 says (EventNodeError), and booted again when it returns.

The manager's objects are in the communication area: an NMT reset of the master's node restores their defaults. Give the dictionary its configuration as defaults (e.g. built from the manager's DCF), or keep it with node.WithStore and save it.

One network boot-up runs at a time. A newer one replaces the one in progress: [Master.BootNetwork](#func-master-bootnetwork) called while the automatic one runs (for example right after Start, having set 0x1F80 bit 0 then), or the automatic one at a reset of the master's node during a BootNetwork call; the replaced call then returns the result of the newer boot-up instead of a cancellation.

The boot slave process repeats an SDO (or USDO) request that times out (BootTiming.SDORetries) in every step whose request can be repeated: the reads of the identity, software identification and configuration date and time, the restore and store requests and every concise DCF entry (writing the same value again), so that a lost frame or a loaded system does not fail the process with a wrong status (D, J...). A program download repeats a timed-out step only after reading the state of the program (0x1F51): the step may have been carried out, its answer late, and the device would refuse it a second time.

With [WithLSSBoot](#func-withlssboot) the network boot-up starts with an LSS step: the master lists the unconfigured devices with LSS Fastscan and gives each the node-ID of the slave of 0x1F81 whose expected identity (0x1F85..0x1F88) it has (EventLSSAssigned); the devices then reset with it and are booted like the others.

The behaviour follows Lely lely-core's NMT master (src/co/nmt.c, nmt\_boot.c, nmt\_cfg.c), CiA 302 being a member document. Not implemented: the flying master and redundancy (0x1F80 bit 5 is ignored), the SDO manager of CiA 302-5 (dynamic SDO connections), the configuration file 0x1F20 (DCF text) and the program objects 0x1F52..0x1F54.

#### LSS {#hdr-LSS}

[Master.LSS](#func-master-lss) is an LSS master (package lss) started and closed with the master: Fastscan, AssignAll, node-ID and bit timing configuration.

#### MPDO {#hdr-MPDO}

[Master.ConfigureMPDO](#func-master-configurempdo) makes a node's PDO a multiplexed PDO; [Master.WriteScannerList](#func-master-writescannerlist) and [Master.WriteDispatcherList](#func-master-writedispatcherlist) write its object scanner and dispatcher lists.

#### CANopen FD {#hdr-CANopen_FD}

With [WithFD](#func-withfd) the master sends NMT commands, SYNC and its heartbeat in CAN FD frames, accepts CAN FD heartbeats and 20-byte emergencies, and reads and writes the nodes' dictionaries with its USDO client ([Master.USDO](#func-master-usdo)) in every procedure (scan, configuration, boot procedures, the CiA 302 boot-up, program download with bulk transfer, remote PDO configuration, CiA 402), since CANopen FD devices serve the USDO in place of the SDO; USDO aborts are reported as SDO aborts (errors.As finds a \*canopen.AbortError). Listen and Sender use CANopen FD PDOs.

## Constants

```go
const (
	// IndexNMTStartup is the NMT start-up value (UNSIGNED32, bits
	// Startup*).
	IndexNMTStartup uint16 = 0x1F80
	// IndexSlaveAssignment is the NMT slave assignment of each node
	// (UNSIGNED32, see [Assignment]).
	IndexSlaveAssignment uint16 = 0x1F81
	// IndexRequestNMT requests an NMT command for a node (UNSIGNED8, the
	// state to reach: 4 stopped, 5 operational, 6 reset node, 7 reset
	// communication, 127 pre-operational; sub-index 128: all nodes); a
	// read returns the node's last known state (0: unknown).
	IndexRequestNMT uint16 = 0x1F82
	// IndexRequestGuarding starts (1) or stops (0) node guarding of a
	// node (UNSIGNED8; sub-index 128: all nodes); a read returns 1 while
	// the node is guarded.
	IndexRequestGuarding uint16 = 0x1F83
	// IndexExpectedDeviceType .. IndexExpectedSerialNumber are the
	// expected identification of each node (UNSIGNED32, 0: not checked),
	// compared with the node's 0x1000 and 0x1018 sub-indices 1..4.
	IndexExpectedDeviceType   uint16 = 0x1F84
	IndexExpectedVendorID     uint16 = 0x1F85
	IndexExpectedProductCode  uint16 = 0x1F86
	IndexExpectedRevision     uint16 = 0x1F87
	IndexExpectedSerialNumber uint16 = 0x1F88
	// IndexBootTime is the time (UNSIGNED32, ms) the manager waits for the
	// mandatory slaves to boot; 0 waits without limit.
	IndexBootTime uint16 = 0x1F89
	// IndexRestoreConfiguration is, for each node with the restore bit
	// of its assignment, the sub-index of the node's 0x1011 the manager
	// writes "load" to before configuring it (UNSIGNED8, 0: none).
	IndexRestoreConfiguration uint16 = 0x1F8A
)
```

Objects of a CiA 302 manager's dictionary (CiA 302-2 network management, CiA 302-3 configuration and program download). The arrays have one sub-index per node-ID (1..127).

```go
const (
	// StartupMaster: the device is the NMT master (else an NMT slave:
	// nothing of the network boot-up runs).
	StartupMaster uint32 = 1 << 0
	// StartupStartAll: start all slaves with one broadcast NMT start
	// (when every slave booted and may be started), else one by one.
	StartupStartAll uint32 = 1 << 1
	// StartupNoAutoOperational: the master does not enter Operational
	// itself after the boot-up; the application does it.
	StartupNoAutoOperational uint32 = 1 << 2
	// StartupNoStartSlaves: the master does not start the slaves; the
	// application does it.
	StartupNoStartSlaves uint32 = 1 << 3
	// StartupResetAllOnError: an error control event of a mandatory
	// slave resets all nodes, the master included (else the slave
	// alone is reset).
	StartupResetAllOnError uint32 = 1 << 4
	// StartupFlyingMaster: the device takes part in the flying master
	// process (CiA 302-2). Not supported: the bit is ignored.
	StartupFlyingMaster uint32 = 1 << 5
	// StartupStopAllOnError: an error control event of a mandatory slave
	// stops all nodes, the master included (takes precedence over
	// StartupResetAllOnError).
	StartupStopAllOnError uint32 = 1 << 6
)
```

Bits of the NMT start-up value 0x1F80 (CiA 302-2, as Lely lely-core implements them).

```go
const (
	// AssignSlave: the node is in the network list.
	AssignSlave uint32 = 1 << 0
	// AssignBoot: the master boots the node (identity check, software
	// and configuration download) and may start it; without it only the
	// error control is started.
	AssignBoot uint32 = 1 << 2
	// AssignMandatory: the network boot-up waits for the node and fails
	// without it.
	AssignMandatory uint32 = 1 << 3
	// AssignKeepAlive: the master does not reset the node at its own
	// boot-up; a node found operational keeps running (boot status L).
	AssignKeepAlive uint32 = 1 << 4
	// AssignVersionCheck: the node's application software
	// identification (0x1F56) is checked against 0x1F55.
	AssignVersionCheck uint32 = 1 << 5
	// AssignSoftwareUpdate: a node with another software is updated
	// from 0x1F58 (needs AssignVersionCheck, not AssignKeepAlive).
	AssignSoftwareUpdate uint32 = 1 << 6
	// AssignRestore: the node's parameters are restored (0x1011, the
	// sub-index of 0x1F8A) before it is configured.
	AssignRestore uint32 = 1 << 7
)
```

Bits of an NMT slave assignment (0x1F81).

## Functions

### func AddManagerObjects

```go
func AddManagerObjects(d *od.Dictionary) error
```

AddManagerObjects adds to d, where missing, the objects of a CiA 302 manager with default values (all 0: the device is an NMT slave until 0x1F80 bit 0 is set, no node is assigned): 0x1F80..0x1F8A, the concise DCFs 0x1F22, the expected configuration date and time 0x1F26 and 0x1F27, the expected application software identification 0x1F55 and the program data 0x1F58. d is then ready for [WithDictionary](#func-withdictionary).

### func Overlay

```go
func Overlay(base pdo.Config, entries []Entry) (pdo.Config, error)
```

Overlay applies entries of one PDO's communication and mapping parameters to a configuration: sub-indices 1 (COB-ID), 2 (transmission type), 3 (inhibit time), 5 (event timer) and 6 (SYNC start value) of the communication parameter; sub-index 0 (number of entries) and 1..64 (entries) of the mapping. Entries of other objects, and sub-indices 0 and 4 of the communication parameter, are ignored.

### type BootConfig

```go
type BootConfig struct {
	// DeviceType, when not 0, must equal 0x1000.
	DeviceType uint32
	// Identity, when set, must match 0x1018; its fields that are 0 are
	// not checked.
	Identity *Identity
	// Entries are written with [Master.Configure].
	Entries []Entry
	// HeartbeatTimeout, when not 0, makes the master supervise the node's
	// heartbeat with it ([Master.Monitor]); configure the node's producer
	// time (0x1017) in Entries.
	HeartbeatTimeout time.Duration
	// NoStart leaves the node in Pre-operational; by default the procedure
	// ends with NMT start.
	NoStart bool
	// Timeout bounds the whole procedure; 0 means DefaultBootTimeout.
	Timeout time.Duration
}
```

BootConfig is the boot procedure of a node (a simplified CiA 302 boot slave process): check the device, configure it, supervise it, start it.

### type BootStatus

```go
type BootStatus byte
```

BootStatus is the result of the boot slave process of CiA 302-2 for a node: 0 (BootOK) or one of the error status letters 'A'..'O' (CiA 302-2; the meanings are those Lely lely-core reports).

```go
const (
	// BootOK: the node booted and its error control started.
	BootOK BootStatus = 0
	// BootNotListed (A): the node is not in the network list (0x1F81
	// bit 0).
	BootNotListed BootStatus = 'A'
	// BootNoResponse (B): no answer to the upload of 0x1000.
	BootNoResponse BootStatus = 'B'
	// BootDeviceType (C): 0x1000 differs from 0x1F84.
	BootDeviceType BootStatus = 'C'
	// BootVendorID (D): 0x1018 sub-index 1 differs from 0x1F85.
	BootVendorID BootStatus = 'D'
	// BootHeartbeat (E): no heartbeat while checking a keep-alive node.
	BootHeartbeat BootStatus = 'E'
	// BootGuarding (F): no node guarding response while checking a
	// keep-alive node.
	BootGuarding BootStatus = 'F'
	// BootProgramObjects (G): the program download objects (0x1F55 of
	// the manager, 0x1F56 of the node) are not configured or not
	// readable.
	BootProgramObjects BootStatus = 'G'
	// BootUpdateNotAllowed (H): the software must be updated but the
	// assignment does not allow it.
	BootUpdateNotAllowed BootStatus = 'H'
	// BootUpdateFailed (I): the software must be updated but the program
	// download failed.
	BootUpdateFailed BootStatus = 'I'
	// BootConfiguration (J): the configuration download failed.
	BootConfiguration BootStatus = 'J'
	// BootErrorControl (K): no heartbeat while starting the error
	// control.
	BootErrorControl BootStatus = 'K'
	// BootOperational (L): the node was found operational (keep-alive):
	// it was not checked nor configured, and keeps running. Not a
	// failure.
	BootOperational BootStatus = 'L'
	// BootProductCode (M): 0x1018 sub-index 2 differs from 0x1F86.
	BootProductCode BootStatus = 'M'
	// BootRevision (N): 0x1018 sub-index 3 differs from 0x1F87.
	BootRevision BootStatus = 'N'
	// BootSerialNumber (O): 0x1018 sub-index 4 differs from 0x1F88.
	BootSerialNumber BootStatus = 'O'
)
```

Boot slave process results.

### type BootTiming

```go
type BootTiming struct {
	// RetryDelay is the wait before a boot slave process is retried
	// after a node did not answer (status B); default 1 s.
	RetryDelay time.Duration
	// SDORetries is the number of times an SDO request that timed out
	// is repeated where a node may still be resetting (the first reads,
	// program control); default 3.
	SDORetries int
	// ResetTimeout bounds the wait for a node's boot-up message after a
	// reset the manager sent; default 1 s.
	ResetTimeout time.Duration
	// GuardTimeout bounds the wait for a node guarding response when
	// checking a keep-alive node without heartbeat; default 100 ms.
	GuardTimeout time.Duration
	// PollInterval is the period of the flash status and program control
	// polling of a program download; default 100 ms.
	PollInterval time.Duration
	// ProgramTimeout bounds a program download (from the stop command
	// to the program started); default 60 s.
	ProgramTimeout time.Duration
}
```

BootTiming are the times of the CiA 302 manager's boot-up. The defaults are those of Lely lely-core (LELY\_CO\_NMT\_BOOT\_\* and LELY\_CO\_NMT\_CFG\_RESET\_TIMEOUT).

### type Entry

```go
type Entry = cdcf.Entry
```

Entry is one value to write into a node's dictionary: the neutral form of a node configuration (from a DCF, a concise DCF, a tool, or code). It is the entry of a concise DCF (package cdcf).

#### func DCFEntries

```go
func DCFEntries(f *eds.File, node canopen.NodeID) ([]Entry, error)
```

DCFEntries returns the configuration a DCF holds for a node, as entries for [Master.Configure](#func-master-configure): every writable sub-object with a ParameterValue (without the "refuse write on download" object flag), in index order, with node-ID-relative values evaluated for node (0: the DCF's DeviceComissioning node-ID). For a PDO with any configured sub-object the whole communication and mapping parameter is included, so that Configure applies the PDO as the DCF describes it. It is [cdcf.Entries](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-canopen/cdcf#Entries).

### type EventKind

```go
type EventKind uint8
```

EventKind is the kind of an [Event](#type-event).

```go
const (
	// EventBootUp: a node sent its boot-up message.
	EventBootUp EventKind = iota + 1
	// EventStateChange: a node's heartbeat reports another state.
	EventStateChange
	// EventHeartbeatLost: a supervised node's heartbeat timed out
	// (reported once per loss).
	EventHeartbeatLost
	// EventHeartbeatResumed: a lost node is heard again.
	EventHeartbeatResumed
	// EventEMCY: a node sent an emergency message (EMCY is set).
	EventEMCY
	// EventBootDone: the boot procedure of a node succeeded.
	EventBootDone
	// EventBootFailed: the boot procedure of a node failed (Err says why;
	// for the CiA 302 boot slave process Status is the error status and
	// Err a *BootError).
	EventBootFailed
	// EventNetworkBootDone: the CiA 302 network boot-up ended, every
	// mandatory slave booted (Node is the master's node-ID).
	EventNetworkBootDone
	// EventNetworkBootFailed: the CiA 302 network boot-up halted because
	// the boot slave process of a mandatory slave (Node) failed; Err is
	// its *BootError.
	EventNetworkBootFailed
	// EventGuardingLost: a node guarded by the CiA 302 manager did not
	// answer (node guarding event).
	EventGuardingLost
	// EventGuardingResumed: a lost guarded node answers again.
	EventGuardingResumed
	// EventNodeError: the CiA 302 manager reacted to the error control
	// event of a slave of the network list (Err says how: reset node,
	// reset all nodes, stop all nodes).
	EventNodeError
	// EventLSSAssigned: the LSS step of the CiA 302 network boot-up
	// ([WithLSSBoot]) gave an unconfigured device the node-ID Node (LSS
	// holds the device's address and the node-ID).
	EventLSSAssigned
)
```

Master is a CANopen network manager: NMT commands, heartbeat supervision, emergency reception, SDO clients for every node, scanning, node configuration, the boot procedure, remote PDOs, SYNC and TIME production and CiA 402 drive control. See the package documentation.

#### func New

```go
func New(bus canopen.Bus, opts ...Option) (*Master, error)
```

New returns a master on bus. It does nothing on the bus until [Master.Start](#func-master-start), except that NMT commands and SDO transfers work at once.

#### func (Master) Boot

```go
func (m *Master) Boot(ctx context.Context, node canopen.NodeID, cfg BootConfig) error
```

Boot runs a boot procedure now: device type and identity check, configuration, heartbeat supervision and NMT start. The node must be pre-operational (or operational) for its SDO server to answer.

```go
func (m *Master) BootNetwork(ctx context.Context) error
```

BootNetwork runs the CiA 302-2 network boot-up now (it runs on its own at every boot-up of the master's node when 0x1F80 bit 0 is set), replacing one in progress: the slaves of the network list (0x1F81) are reset (communication), the mandatory and keep-alive ones booted at once and the others when their boot-up message arrives; it returns when every mandatory slave booted (nil, after which the master enters Operational unless 0x1F80 bit 2 is set, and starts the slaves as 0x1F80 says) or one failed (its \*BootError: the boot-up halts, the master stays pre-operational). Without bit 0 of 0x1F80 it does nothing.

One network boot-up runs at a time: a newer one (another BootNetwork call, or the automatic one at a boot-up of the master's node) cancels the one in progress, and a call whose boot-up was replaced waits for the newer one and returns its result; it returns ctx's error only when ctx ends, and the cancellation when the master is closed.

#### func (Master) BootSlave

```go
func (m *Master) BootSlave(ctx context.Context, id canopen.NodeID) error
```

BootSlave runs the CiA 302-2 boot slave process of a node now and waits for it: the checks of the node's identity (0x1F84..0x1F88), software (0x1F55, with an update from 0x1F58 when allowed) and configuration (0x1F26/0x1F27 against the node's 0x1020, the concise DCF 0x1F22), then the start of the error control and, as 0x1F80 allows, of the node. It fails with canopen.ErrBusy while one runs for the node, and with a \*BootError when the process fails; it is not repeated when the node does not answer.

#### func (Master) Close

```go
func (m *Master) Close() error
```

Close stops the services, the boot procedures in progress, the remote PDO listeners and the SDO clients, and waits for them. Queued events are delivered before it returns.

#### func (Master) Configure

```go
func (m *Master) Configure(ctx context.Context, node canopen.NodeID, entries []Entry) error
```

Configure writes a configuration to a node. Entries outside the PDO parameters (0x1400..0x1BFF) are written first, in the given order. Entries of PDO parameters are grouped per PDO, applied over the PDO's current configuration (read from the node) and written with pdo.Configure, in the order the PDOs first appear: so the sequence CiA 301 requires (invalidate, clear the mapping, map, enable, make valid) is kept however the entries are ordered. An EMCY (0x1014), SYNC (0x1005) or TIME (0x1012) COB-ID that changes the CAN-ID of an object in use is preceded by a write of the current COB-ID without its in-use bits, since devices refuse that change (CiA 301). The first failure stops the configuration; the error names the entry or the PDO.

#### func (Master) ConfigureConcise

```go
func (m *Master) ConfigureConcise(ctx context.Context, node canopen.NodeID, entries []Entry) error
```

ConfigureConcise writes entries to a node one by one, in their order, as a CiA 302 manager writes a concise DCF (0x1F22): unlike [Master.Configure](#func-master-configure) nothing is regrouped, so the entries must hold the sequence the node needs (see cdcf.PDOSequence). The first failure stops it; the error names the entry.

#### func (Master) ConfigureFromDCF

```go
func (m *Master) ConfigureFromDCF(ctx context.Context, node canopen.NodeID, f *eds.File) error
```

ConfigureFromDCF writes the configuration of a DCF to a node ([DCFEntries](#func-dcfentries), [Master.Configure](#func-master-configure)). node 0 takes the DCF's node-ID.

#### func (Master) ConfigureMPDO

```go
func (m *Master) ConfigureMPDO(ctx context.Context, node canopen.NodeID, transmit bool, n int, mode uint8, cob canopen.COBID, inhibit uint16) error
```

ConfigureMPDO makes TPDO (transmit) or RPDO n of a node a multiplexed PDO (CiA 301, package mpdo): mode mpdo.MappingSAM (0xFE) or mpdo.MappingDAM (0xFF), on COB-ID cob, event-driven (transmission type 254), with the inhibit time inhibit (100 µs, TPDO). The PDO is written with the sequence of pdo.Configure; the node (package node) creates its MPDO producer or consumer when the mapping becomes an MPDO.

#### func (Master) ConfigurePDO

```go
func (m *Master) ConfigurePDO(ctx context.Context, node canopen.NodeID, transmit bool, n int, cfg pdo.Config) error
```

ConfigurePDO writes the configuration of TPDO (transmit) or RPDO n of a node with pdo.Configure.

#### func (Master) DownloadProgram

```go
func (m *Master) DownloadProgram(ctx context.Context, node canopen.NodeID, data []byte, opts ProgramOptions) error
```

DownloadProgram replaces the program of a node (CiA 302-3 program download, in the sequence of Lely lely-core's boot slave process):

 1. read the program control 0x1F51; unless it reads 0 (stopped), write 0 (stop program), ignoring a timeout (the node may restart into its bootloader);
 2. write 3 (clear program), repeated while it times out;
 3. download data to the program data 0x1F50 with an SDO block transfer, or a segmented one when the node refuses block transfer;
 4. poll the flash status 0x1F57 until programming ends (bit 0 clear), failing with its error code (a program.FlashError);
 5. compare 0x1F56 with opts.Identification, when set;
 6. write 1 (start program), ignoring a timeout;
 7. poll 0x1F51 until it reads 1 (started).

The node must be pre-operational.

#### func (Master) Drive

```go
func (m *Master) Drive(node canopen.NodeID, opts *cia402.ControllerOptions) *cia402.Controller
```

Drive returns a CiA 402 controller for the drive at a node, using the node's SDO client ([Master.SDO](#func-master-sdo)); opts may be nil. An invalid node-ID surfaces as the error of the controller's first operation.

#### func (Master) Identity

```go
func (m *Master) Identity(ctx context.Context, node canopen.NodeID) (Identity, error)
```

Identity reads the identity object 0x1018 of a node.

#### func (Master) LSS

```go
func (m *Master) LSS() *lss.Master
```

LSS returns the master's LSS master (CiA 305, package lss), started and closed with the master: Fastscan, node-ID assignment (AssignAll), bit timing. Its services need [Master.Start](#func-master-start).

#### func (Master) LastEMCY

```go
func (m *Master) LastEMCY(node canopen.NodeID) (emcy.Event, bool)
```

LastEMCY returns the last emergency message of a node.

#### func (Master) Listen

```go
func (m *Master) Listen(cob canopen.COBID, mapping pdo.Mapping, desc *od.Dictionary, h func(f *canbus.Frame, values []pdo.Value)) (*pdo.Listener, error)
```

Listen starts a listener for PDOs on a COB-ID with a known mapping, whose objects desc describes (a dictionary of the producing node, for example built from its EDS). With [WithFD](#func-withfd) the PDOs are CANopen FD PDOs (up to 64 bytes, pdo.WithFD). The handler runs on the listener's goroutine. The listener is closed with the master, or earlier by the caller.

#### func (Master) ListenTPDO

```go
func (m *Master) ListenTPDO(ctx context.Context, node canopen.NodeID, n int, desc *od.Dictionary, h func(f *canbus.Frame, values []pdo.Value)) (*pdo.Listener, error)
```

ListenTPDO reads the configuration of TPDO n of a node over SDO and starts a listener for it (see [Master.Listen](#func-master-listen)). It fails when the TPDO is not active (invalid COB-ID or empty mapping).

#### func (Master) Monitor

```go
func (m *Master) Monitor(node canopen.NodeID, timeout time.Duration) error
```

Monitor supervises a node's heartbeat with a consumer heartbeat time (at least the node's producer time plus a margin); 0 ends the supervision. The node's state is tracked whether supervised or not.

```go
func (m *Master) NMT(ctx context.Context, node canopen.NodeID, cmd canopen.NMTCommand) error
```

NMT sends an NMT command to a node, or to all nodes with node-ID 0.

```go
func (m *Master) Node() *node.Node
```



PreOperational sends NMT enter pre-operational to a node (0: all).


RPDOSender reads the configuration of RPDO n of a node over SDO and returns a sender of that PDO (see [Master.Sender](#func-master-sender)). It fails when the RPDO is not active.

#### func (Master) ReadPDO

```go
func (m *Master) ReadPDO(ctx context.Context, node canopen.NodeID, transmit bool, n int) (pdo.Config, error)
```

ReadPDO reads the configuration of TPDO (transmit) or RPDO n of a node.

#### func (Master) ResetCommunication

```go
func (m *Master) ResetCommunication(ctx context.Context, node canopen.NodeID) error
```

ResetCommunication sends NMT reset communication to a node (0: all).

#### func (Master) ResetNode

```go
func (m *Master) ResetNode(ctx context.Context, node canopen.NodeID) error
```

ResetNode sends NMT reset node to a node (0: all).

#### func (Master) RestoreDefaults

```go
func (m *Master) RestoreDefaults(ctx context.Context, node canopen.NodeID, group uint8) error
```

RestoreDefaults asks a node to restore the default values of a group of its parameters from its next reset on: it writes the signature "load" to 0x1011 sub-index group.

#### func (Master) SDO

```go
func (m *Master) SDO(node canopen.NodeID) (*sdo.Client, error)
```

SDO returns the SDO client of a node (default COB-IDs 0x600/0x580 + node-ID), created on first use with the options of [WithSDOOptions](#func-withsdooptions) and kept until Close. A client serialises its transfers; clients of different nodes work in parallel.

#### func (Master) SYNC

```go
func (m *Master) SYNC() *syncobj.Producer
```

SYNC returns the master's SYNC producer (COB-ID 0x080): set a period ([syncobj.Producer.SetPeriod](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-canopen/sync#Producer.SetPeriod)) to produce SYNC cyclically, or send one with [syncobj.Producer.Send](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-canopen/sync#Producer.Send).

#### func (Master) Scan

```go
func (m *Master) Scan(ctx context.Context, nodes []canopen.NodeID) ([]NodeInfo, error)
```

Scan queries nodes in parallel (all of 1..127 when nodes is empty) with SDO uploads of the device type 0x1000 and the identity 0x1018, and returns the nodes that answered, by node-ID. A request that times out is repeated once. A node that does not answer 0x1000 is absent; one that answers 0x1000 but fails on 0x1018 sub 1 (mandatory) is reported with that error in the joined error, as are invalid node-IDs. Scan uses its own SDO clients ([WithScanOptions](#func-withscanoptions)).

#### func (Master) Sender

```go
func (m *Master) Sender(cob canopen.COBID, mapping pdo.Mapping, desc *od.Dictionary) (*pdo.Sender, error)
```

Sender returns a sender of PDOs on a COB-ID with a known mapping, whose objects desc describes; with [WithFD](#func-withfd) it sends CANopen FD PDOs.

#### func (Master) SetBoot

```go
func (m *Master) SetBoot(node canopen.NodeID, cfg *BootConfig) error
```

SetBoot registers the boot procedure of a node: from then on, every boot-up message of the node starts it in the background (a boot-up during a procedure cancels it and starts again), and its end is reported as EventBootDone or EventBootFailed. nil removes the registration.

#### func (Master) SlaveStatus

```go
func (m *Master) SlaveStatus(id canopen.NodeID) (status BootStatus, done bool)
```

SlaveStatus returns the result of the last boot slave process of a node: done is false before the first one ended and while one runs.

#### func (Master) Start

```go
func (m *Master) Start() error
```

Start starts the heartbeat consumer, the emergency consumer, the event delivery, the SYNC and TIME producers and the master's heartbeat.

```go
func (m *Master) StartNode(ctx context.Context, node canopen.NodeID) error

```


StoreParameters asks a node to save a group of its parameters: it writes the signature "save" to 0x1010 sub-index group (store.All, store.Communication, store.Application, store.Manufacturer).

```go
func (m *Master) TIME() *timestamp.Producer
```

TIME returns the master's TIME producer (COB-ID 0x100), which sends the time on [timestamp.Producer.Send](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-canopen/timestamp#Producer.Send).

#### func (Master) USDO

```go
func (m *Master) USDO() (*usdo.Client, error)
```

USDO returns the master's USDO client (CANopen FD, package usdo) of [WithFD](#func-withfd) or [WithUSDOClient](#func-withusdoclient): one client addresses every server (a node, a group, all), several transfers at once. It fails with ErrNoUSDO without those options and with canopen.ErrClosed after Close.

```go
func (m *Master) WaitBootUp(ctx context.Context, node canopen.NodeID, since time.Time) error
```

#### func (Master) WriteScannerList

```go
func (m *Master) WriteScannerList(ctx context.Context, node canopen.NodeID, list int, entries []mpdo.ScannerEntry) error
```

WriteScannerList writes object scanner list number list (1..48, 0x1FA0+list-1) of a node: entries to sub-indices 1.., then the number of entries to sub-index 00h (skipped when the node's list has a constant size, abort "read only").

### type NodeInfo

```go
type NodeInfo struct {
	Node canopen.NodeID `json:"node"`
	// DeviceType is 0x1000.
	DeviceType uint32 `json:"deviceType"`
	// Identity is 0x1018; sub-indices 2..4 are optional and read as 0
	// when the node lacks them.
	Identity Identity `json:"identity"`
}
```

NodeInfo is what [Master.Scan](#func-master-scan) learnt of a node.

### type Option

```go
type Option func(*config)
```

Option configures a [Master](#type-master).

#### func WithBootTiming

```go
func WithBootTiming(t BootTiming) Option
```

WithBootTiming sets the times of the CiA 302 boot-up and of [Master.DownloadProgram](#func-master-downloadprogram); zero fields keep their defaults.

#### func WithDictionary

```go
func WithDictionary(d *od.Dictionary, opts ...node.Option) Option
```

WithDictionary makes the master a CANopen device of its own, built from d with package node (its node-ID is d's): the master then has an SDO server, a heartbeat producer (0x1017) and the other services of its dictionary, and is a CiA 302 manager driven by the objects of d (see [AddManagerObjects](#func-addmanagerobjects) and the package documentation): with bit 0 of the NMT start-up 0x1F80 set, every boot-up of the master's node (at Start and after its resets) runs the network boot-up of CiA 302-2 over the slaves of 0x1F81, configuring them from their concise DCFs (0x1F22). opts are passed to node.New (e.g. node.WithStore); the master sets the node's state handler (the node's state changes are reported as EventStateChange events of its node-ID) and leaves out its heartbeat consumer (the master supervises the slaves of 0x1016 itself). [WithHeartbeat](#func-withheartbeat) cannot be combined with it (0x1017 sets the heartbeat).

#### func WithEventHandler

```go
func WithEventHandler(h func(Event)) Option
```

WithEventHandler sets the function every [Event](#type-event) is delivered to. Events are delivered one at a time, in the order they occurred, on a goroutine of the master's own: the handler may call the master (SDO transfers, NMT commands) but not [Master.Close](#func-master-close). A slow handler delays later events, never the services. Events driven by bus frames (EventBootUp, EventStateChange, EventEMCY) wait in a bounded queue ([WithEventQueue](#func-witheventqueue)): when it is full the oldest of them is dropped and counted in [Stats](#type-stats).EventsDropped. The results of the master's own processes (boot, network boot, LSS, node error) and supervision events (heartbeat and guarding loss and resumption) are never dropped.

#### func WithEventQueue

```go
func WithEventQueue(n int) Option
```

WithEventQueue sets how many bus-driven events (EventBootUp, EventStateChange, EventEMCY) the master holds for an event handler that does not keep up; n \<= 0 means DefaultEventQueue. When the queue is full the oldest of them is dropped, so that a flood of frames cannot grow the master's memory.

#### func WithFD

```go
func WithFD(brs bool) Option
```

WithFD makes the master a CANopen FD manager (CiA 1301), with bit rate switching when brs is true: NMT commands, its heartbeat and SYNC are sent in CAN FD frames, the heartbeat and emergency consumers accept CAN FD frames (emergencies of 20 bytes are reported with emcy.Event.FD), and every procedure that reads or writes a node's dictionary (scan, configuration, boot procedures, the CiA 302 boot-up, program download, remote PDO configuration, CiA 402) uses the master's USDO client ([Master.USDO](#func-master-usdo)) instead of SDO, since CANopen FD devices serve the USDO in place of the SDO. [Master.SDO](#func-master-sdo) still returns classical SDO clients (for classical devices on the same network). TIME stays classical. With [WithDictionary](#func-withdictionary) the master's own node runs in CANopen FD mode as well (node.WithFD).

#### func WithHeartbeat

```go
func WithHeartbeat(id canopen.NodeID, period time.Duration) Option
```

WithHeartbeat makes the master produce a heartbeat as node id every period (state Operational), for nodes that supervise the master with 0x1016.

#### func WithLSSBoot

```go
func WithLSSBoot(o lss.FastscanOptions) Option
```

WithLSSBoot adds the LSS step to the CiA 302 network boot-up ([WithDictionary](#func-withdictionary)): before the slaves are reset, the master lists the unconfigured devices with LSS Fastscan (options o) and gives each the node-ID of the slave of the network list (0x1F81) whose expected identity (vendor 0x1F85, product 0x1F86, revision 0x1F87, serial 0x1F88; zero values are not compared, at least one must be set) it matches, unless that node-ID is assigned already; the devices then apply it (reset communication) and boot. The Fastscan is repeated (up to 4 rounds) while a round assigns node-IDs, since a lost frame can hide a device. A device that matches no slave, or more than one, keeps no node-ID (the master logs it); node-IDs already used by configured devices are not checked. Each assignment is reported as an EventLSSAssigned.

#### func WithLSSOptions

```go
func WithLSSOptions(opts ...lss.MasterOption) Option
```

WithLSSOptions sets the options of the master's LSS master ([Master.LSS](#func-master-lss)): timeouts, retries, inhibit time, Fastscan window.

#### func WithLogger

```go
func WithLogger(l *slog.Logger) Option
```

WithLogger logs the master's events, and those of its services, to l. The default logs nothing.

#### func WithSDOOptions

```go
func WithSDOOptions(opts ...sdo.ClientOption) Option
```

WithSDOOptions sets the options of the SDO clients [Master.SDO](#func-master-sdo) creates (timeout, retries, block mode...).

#### func WithScanOptions

```go
func WithScanOptions(opts ...sdo.ClientOption) Option
```

WithScanOptions sets the options of the SDO clients [Master.Scan](#func-master-scan) uses (default: a 100 ms timeout, so that absent nodes are passed quickly).

#### func WithScanParallelism

```go
func WithScanParallelism(n int) Option
```

WithScanParallelism sets how many nodes [Master.Scan](#func-master-scan) queries at once (default 16).

#### func WithStoreAfterConfigure

```go
func WithStoreAfterConfigure(group uint8) Option
```

WithStoreAfterConfigure makes the CiA 302 boot-up ask a slave to save its parameters (0x1010 sub-index group, see [Master.StoreParameters](#func-master-storeparameters)) after a concise DCF was written to it, so that the configuration survives the slave's restart; with the configuration date and time in the concise DCF (0x1020) and in 0x1F26/0x1F27, the next boot-up then skips the configuration. 0 (the default) asks for nothing.

#### func WithUSDOClient

```go
func WithUSDOClient(id canopen.NodeID, opts ...usdo.Option) Option
```

WithUSDOClient gives the master a USDO client ([Master.USDO](#func-master-usdo)) with node-ID id (its requests go out on 600h + id), with options (timeout, processing time unit...). [WithFD](#func-withfd) creates one without this option, with the node-ID of [WithDictionary](#func-withdictionary), else that of [WithHeartbeat](#func-withheartbeat), else 127.

### type ProgramOptions

```go
type ProgramOptions struct {
	// Program is the program number (sub-index of 0x1F50, 0x1F51,
	// 0x1F56, 0x1F57); default 1.
	Program uint8
	// Identification, when not 0, must equal the node's application
	// software identification 0x1F56 once the image is written, before
	// the program is started.
	Identification uint32
	// Timing gives the polling interval, the SDO retries and the bound
	// of the whole download (BootTiming.ProgramTimeout); zero fields
	// take the master's ([WithBootTiming]).
	Timing BootTiming
}
```

ProgramOptions control [Master.DownloadProgram](#func-master-downloadprogram).

### type Stats

```go
type Stats struct {
	NMT       nmt.MasterStats                    `json:"nmt"`
	Heartbeat nmt.HeartbeatConsumerStats         `json:"heartbeat"`
	EMCY      emcy.ConsumerStats                 `json:"emcy"`
	SYNC      syncobj.ProducerStats              `json:"sync"`
	TIME      timestamp.ProducerStats            `json:"time"`
	SDO       map[canopen.NodeID]sdo.ClientStats `json:"sdo"`
	LSS       lss.MasterStats                    `json:"lss"`
	USDO      usdo.ClientStats                   `json:"usdo"` // WithFD or WithUSDOClient
	// EventsDropped counts bus-driven events dropped from the full event
	// queue of a handler that did not keep up ([WithEventQueue]).
	EventsDropped uint64 `json:"eventsDropped"`
}
```

Stats is a snapshot of the master's counters.
